  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  February 27, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1+ (669) 900-6833;
meeting ID 982 4253 6876 and Password 828281 on February 27, 2025 at 2:03 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Christine Rivera , Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LA County Fire Department
  Sgt.Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department – 2:04 pm
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk’s Department
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on February 13, 2025.
Approval of the Minutes of the special meeting held on February 13, 2025

New Business License Request (s):

Item #1:  Quynh Nguyen DBA Q Nails to operate as a Hair / Nail Salon at 300 W. Manchester Blvd.
  APPROVED CONDITIONALL SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  Payment of annual business license and tax fees; Business owner must possess and
  maintain valid and current Establishment License from the State Board of Barbering &
  Cosmetology;Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating within the
  establishment must possess applicable licenses from the State Board of Barbering &
  Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating within the
  establishment is required to register and file business tax with the City; Business owner shall
  provide valid and current government-issued identification and copies of applicable state
  licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the establishment to the
  Finance Department; Parties, social events or gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited;
  Consumption of alcoholic beverages, narcotic drug use (including cannabis activity) is not
  permitted on the premises; Massage therapy of any part of the body is not permitted; Subject
  to random inspections by any City Code Enforcement Officer or any Peace Officer at any

  time to ensure compliance; Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules
  and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and any future
  business license application requests. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00404934)

Item #2:  Ervin Fullwood II DBA Wound Pros Parking to operate as a Parking Lot at 101 S. Prairie Ave.
  APPROVED CONDITIONALL SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS:
  APPROVED  CONDITIONALLY  SUBJECT  TO  THE  FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees, an expired or lapsed
  license for more than six months will negatively impact your license renewal;Remittances of
  Parking Tax by the 20th of each month following collection;Approval for Special Event Parking
  for Forum events only; Special Event Parking must not start before 6 pm Monday through
  Friday;On Site business must be closed 1 hour before Event Parking starts. Parking
  attendant or security guard must be on site during event parking at all times;Ensure safe
  pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site and;Adhere to all State, Federal and
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to
  comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business
  license and any future business license application requests. Motion carried
  unanimously ( Activity No. 00385500)
Held Over from 01.23.25

Item #3:  Ahmed Saad DBA PCH Oil Enterprise Inc. to operate as a Tobacco Retailer Shop at 3100
  W. Manchester Blvd. APPROVED CONDITIONALL SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: This Business License has been APPROVED with the following
  condition set forth by the Permits and Licenses Committee:Must adhere to all City of
  Inglewood Municipal Codes (IMC), specifically; CHAPTER 8: Article 8. REGULATIONS
  FOR BUSINESSES ENGAGED IN THE SALE OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS;Must adhere
  to all State and Federal Rules and Regulations; Retail area not exceed 32 Square Feet of
  total retail floor area Sales or display of single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; Sales of
  Flavored E-Cigarettes , Flavored Vapes ,Flavored E-juice, Flavored Pods, Flavored
  Cartridges, Menthol Cigarettes; Flavored little Cigars, Flavored Cigarillos, Flavored
  Smokeless Tobacco Products, Flavored Blunts Wraps, Flavored loose-leaf roll-your-own
  Tobacco, Flavored Tobacco rolling papers, Tobacco Product Flavored Enhancers are
  Strictly Prohibited;Sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and e-cigarette products to minors,
  under age 21 is strictly prohibited; Persons purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco
  products shall have a valid government-issued identification on their person at all times to
  enforce laws restricting underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; Sales
  or display of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray, Taser/Stun
  guns is strictly prohibited;Tobacco Retailer business owners and/or new applicants or their
  designees are subject to random Permits & Licenses establishment inspections at any time
  of the day or night by any Police or Code Enforcement Officers, purpose of random
  inspections is to enforce business establishments to adhere to the regulations set forth by
  the City of Inglewood for Community Public Health & Safety;California State Board of
  Equalization Tobacco Retailers license must be current Approval for retail sales of tobacco
 Permits & License Committee  February 27, 2025
Minutes  Page 3 of 5

  products within existing business ONLY;NO sales of tobacco (including vaporized / hookah
  products) to minors / underage persons. All persons purchasing tobacco or any related
  tobacco products SHALL have valid ID on their person at all times to ensure the restriction
  of underage tobacco use, including hookah products;Submit all state tobacco renewal
  certificates if applicable;NO loitering of persons outside of the location;NO LOITERING /
  PANHANDLING SIGNS MUST BE POSTED and visible to outside of the business. Proof
  of signage posted by applicant shall be submitted to finance (i.e. photo of signage); The
  following is not allowed: the “sales of Whippets are small cylinders of nitrous oxide”, the
  use of or illegal sales or cultivation of marijuana/cannabis products, any regulated cannabis
  products, any use or possession of illegal or unauthorized narcotics, narcotic paraphernalia
  per H&S11364.5 - i.e.; any pipes specifically used to ingest illegal narcotics, this would also
  include glass cylindrical, tube or bubble shaped pipes used specifically to smoke / ingest
  illegal narcotics. Sales of Tobacco pipes are acceptable; Applicant and employees are
  expected to be active participants in calling/notifying police for police related, unusual,
  illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police response or response from other city
  government services (i.e. Code Enforcement, Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept.,
  Etc.);Applicant and employees are expected to be active participants in calling/notifying
  police for police related, unusual, illegal, and/or activity that may necessitate a police
  response or response from other city government services (i.e. Code Enforcement,
  Planning, Finance, Public Works, Fire Dept., Etc.); andThe following is not allowed inside
  the business without proper authorization via the P&L Committee review and permit:
  PARTIES, SOCIAL EVENTS OR GATHERINGS OF ANYKIND, MUSIC BOXES (juke box),
  NO LIVE BANDS / MUSIC, DISC JOCKIES (DJ'S) PERFORMANCE, DANCE HALL, ETC.
  APPLICANT MUST HAVE REASONABLE BUSINESS HOURS (TIME OF DAY OR
  NIGHT) OF OPERATION. Motion carried unanimously ( Activity No. 00395587)
